nodes.title: 《精神现象学》(Phänomenologie des Geistes) ⭐
nodes.summary: This partial document provides an overview of Hegel's "Phenomenology of Spirit" (Phänomenologie des Geistes), highlighting its significance as stated by Marx, who called it the "true birthplace and secret of Hegel's philosophy." It lists different translations and versions of the book, recommending the He Lin/Wang Jiuxing translation published by the Commercial Press as the classic choice and Deng Xiaomang's translation for its rigorous literal approach. The document also provides links to various resources for accessing the book, including the WeChat Reading version of He Lin's complete works, a PDF version from Keyllo, and an English version available on marxists.org.

nodes.title: 《逻辑学》(Wissenschaft der Logik) — 大逻辑
nodes.summary: The partial document provides information about the book "Logic" (Wissenschaft der Logik) by Hegel, also known as "Greater Logic." It highlights the standard Chinese translation by Yang Yizhi, published by the Commercial Press in two volumes, and emphasizes its status as the academic standard. The document includes direct links to PDF versions of both the upper and lower volumes, a link to the book on WeChat Reading, and a link to the English version on marxists.org titled "Science of Logic."

nodes.title: 《小逻辑》(Enzyklopädie, Teil 1)
nodes.summary: The partial document provides information about the book "Lesser Logic" (Enzyklopädie, Teil 1) by Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel. It highlights a recommended version translated by He Lin, published by the Commercial Press in 1980, suggesting it as a classic introduction before studying Hegel's larger works. The document includes links to a PDF version of He Lin's translation, a GitHub repository containing the text in plain format, and an English version available on marxists.org titled "Shorter Logic."
